purpose: Teach: 月別/予備校/破損/労災/ストレージ/辞職/役に立っ/明言

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時から、月別の数字、しっかり、把握してきたな、私。
lines.en: From the beginning, I made sure to keep track of the monthly numbers properly.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Quiet pride in the statement. Pause on 'properly'—the weight of decades of careful stewardship. Warm, settled tone. Slight trailing warmth on 'me.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員、予備校時代から、当社を、目指してきた人材、増えています。
lines.en: Yes. We're seeing more staff now who aimed for this company from their cram school days.
lines.style: Respectful, clear response. Slight lift on 'increased'—genuine warmth at the trend. Steady eye contact. Professional but genuinely pleased. No performative earnestness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時の機械の破損、皆で、手作業で、修理したな、思い出だ。
lines.en: The equipment we broke down at the start—we all fixed it by hand together. That's a memory.
lines.style: Softly nostalgic, almost to himself. Slight smile in the voice. Slows on 'memory'—not lecturing, just remembering. Gentle exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。労災ゼロ、創業以来の、誇りです、当社の。
lines.en: Yes. Zero workplace incidents since we started—that's our company's pride.
lines.style: Firm conviction on 'zero.' Voice lifts slightly with genuine commitment. Formal but warm—speaking to something that matters deeply. Steady delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今は、ストレージって、便利な時代になったよな、私の頃には、なかった。
lines.en: These days, storage systems are so convenient. We didn't have anything like that back when I was starting out.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly amazed. Not envious—just noticing how much easier things are now. Wistful but warm. The tone of someone marveling at progress he won't fully see.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業者の辞職時、社員一同、感動した日でした、お父さん。
lines.en: Yes. The day you stepped down as founder—all the staff were deeply moved, Dad.
lines.style: Tender, quiet sincerity. The title 'Dad' carries both affection and respect. Slower pace on that memory. Voice steadies—this is important. No flourish, just presence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期の苦労、本当に、役に立った経験、後輩に、伝えろ。
lines.en: The hardships we went through in those early days—they were truly valuable. Pass that on to the younger people.
lines.style: Direct, weighted with purpose. Not harsh—gentle but clear. The voice of someone giving real instruction, not just reminiscing. Slight emphasis on 'pass it on.' Grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業精神、私の代でも、明言してまいります。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the founding spirit carries forward in my time too.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Formal enough to honor the moment, warm enough to feel genuine. Deliberate on 'my time'—a gentle assertion of continuity. Closing with steady presence.
